name: Tabitha
overview: The Scripture introduces Tabitha, also called Dorcas, as a devoted Christian woman in Joppa known for her good works and acts of charity (Acts 9:36). When she fell ill and died, the disciples sent for Peter, who came promptly and, through prayer, restored her to life (Acts 9:37-41). This account highlights both the impact of Tabitha's faithful service to others and the power of God working through the apostle Peter to bring life and hope to the early church.
